title: Vesper and the Contact
author: Marguerite Halloran
blurb: Cyrus Kavanagh, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, works cases no one wants attributed. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
